hour.description: Hour at which the customized start of day begins according to the given timezone. Must be a [supported customized start of day hour](/connect/customized-start-of-day#available-timezones-and-cutoffs).

minutes.description: Minutes at which the customized start of day begins according to the given timezone. Must be either 0 or 30.

timezone.description: Timezone for the customized start of day. Must be a [supported customized start of day timezone](/connect/customized-start-of-day#available-timezones-and-cutoffs).
